### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, touching **2** documentable anchor(s).

**3** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx`  _(via sys_oauth_application (symbol, a field of const object enObjects; a field of const object esESObjects; a field of const object jaJPObjects; a field of const object zhCNObjects))_
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx`  _(via sys_oauth_application (symbol, a field of const object enObjects; a field of const object esESObjects; a field of const object jaJPObjects; a field of const object zhCNObjects))_
- `content/docs/ui/setup-app.mdx`  _(via sys_oauth_application (symbol, a field of const object enObjects; a field of const object esESObjects; a field of const object jaJPObjects; a field of const object zhCNObjects))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **3** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 93e6c1a5f8bf256310f9ed477523ff2c90bf1bff` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `3f42eb2396af9b026cb045e656dedb320ef8e13a` — the merge of head `fd686be8e05fc588d8ba2ee6538ec6a2a46e5b70` into base `93e6c1a5f8bf256310f9ed477523ff2c90bf1bff`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 3f42eb2396af9b026cb045e656dedb320ef8e13a && git checkout 3f42eb2396af9b026cb045e656dedb320ef8e13a
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 93e6c1a5f8bf256310f9ed477523ff2c90bf1bff fd686be8e05fc588d8ba2ee6538ec6a2a46e5b70 && git checkout -B drift-repro 93e6c1a5f8bf256310f9ed477523ff2c90bf1bff && git merge --no-ff fd686be8e05fc588d8ba2ee6538ec6a2a46e5b70

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 93e6c1a5f8bf256310f9ed477523ff2c90bf1bff
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 93e6c1a5f8bf256310f9ed477523ff2c90bf1bff` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对

ACCEPT · #24773 half 2b · `domain:services` seat 2 · `os-support-ai` · `session_01UmqzD97e14iws6hmVhgZ5y` · 2026-10-21T00:46Z · head `fd686be8e0`.
- This is the review of record for the claim `6302570331`, as widened in place for half 2b.
- Contract review: not owed. The PR touches no published schema and no governed path, and it declares `Clause-②: no` with no narrowing arm.
- The register door's accept set is unchanged: the dev measured it live.

1. **Form:**
   - The first line is `Part of #24773`. The seat's grep finds no closing keyword beside an issue number.
   - `Clause-②: no` is at line start in the body and in the `platform-objects` changeset (`patch`), with its reason.
   - 7 files, +185/−23.
   - Path face: `check-governed-merges --pr 25011` reports 0 of 7 paths governed. Ordinary queue landing.
   - Cross-lane: `platform-objects` (`domain:engine`), declared in the widened claim.
2. **Premise and fix:**
   - Ruling D (`6293344532`): the form offers only Web and Native (required, default Web). The Redirect URLs help states the provider's rule per type: Web needs https on a non-loopback host; Native may also use http on exactly `localhost`, `127.0.0.1` or `[::1]`, any port. A new Application Type help says when to choose Native.
   - **The stop condition, measured negative, live on a dev server.** Nothing on the server reads the action's param options:
     - the generic action door refuses a `type: 'api'` action before its param contract runs;
     - the register route reads the raw body.
     - So `user-agent-based` / `public` sent to the route still register as `web`, with PR #24992's warning.
   - **The stored `type` select and the `public` column are untouched.**
   - **Pins:** 7 source-reading cases, among them the four locales' options and help, the stored column still declared four-valued, and the `public` column still a boolean.
   - **Ablations** A–G each went red as predicted and were restored to the HEAD blob.
3. **Gates:**
   - CI on `fd686be8e0`, latest run per check name: 41 checks, 34 success, 7 skipped, 0 failed.
   - Every skip is on the roster in `scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs` (read from the file): Packed-tarball smoke, the 18.x upgrade harness, the Dogfood Regression Gate matrix, Temporal Conformance, Dogfood Verify CLI, Console Pin Gate and Build Docs.
   - Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are both `success`.
   - Local: 66 derived, 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. The `platform-objects` suite: 83 files, 1239 passed. Typecheck with `check:test-typecheck` exits 0. `check:i18n` and `check:i18n-stale-fill` are clean.
4. **Accepted deviations:**
   - The action is `create_oauth_application` (label "Register OAuth Application"), not the name the dispatch used.
   - The help also states `[::1]` and any port, each measured live through the provider's own route.
   - The stored-column pin holds the declared values as they are (see 5).
   - **One stale sentence, carried forward rather than reworked:** the object's new code comment says refusing `user-agent-based` / `public` "waits for a major version". The maintainer's amendment of 「甲」 (`6303865025`), which came during this run, overtook that. Half 2c, dispatched next, lands the 18.x refusal and corrects that comment in the same region.
   - Prose read sentence by sentence against the diff: the changeset's Redirect URLs help, Application Type help and Unchanged bullets.
5. **Out of scope:**
   - **`Field.select`'s string-array shorthand strips hyphens from option values:** the stored column declares `useragentbased`, and `sys_metadata_audit.lock_state` declares `nooverlay` / `nodelete`. Filed as #25013 (ungraded, spec).
   - **The stored-column readings** (1.7.3 writes only `web` / `native`, never `public`) are carried by half 2c.
6. **Landing:** ordinary queue landing. Every check on this head is green or an expected skip, so the seat flips it on this record. Half 2c (the 400, now 18.x) is dispatched when this lands.
